_doc: Ballistic Shield (Fuze). research/weapons.csv row ballistic_shield; rules research/weapons_notes.md §5; built in Phase 8 M11 (gadgets/DESIGN.md §8). Held with the secondary pistol: no hip fire; aiming takes `pistolAdsS` and lowers the plate's top under the eyes. Bash damage 0 (Y9S4, the official Collision Point page) supersedes fuze.md's 65 (Y9S1); it pushes its target back. Bullets stop at its plate (hits suppress the carrier: 5 to start, 20 at most, ~7 s to fade). A blast from in front loses 66% (Y9S1.3); one of 30 hp or more, a knife or a stun knocks it aside (guard break, ~1 s); Sledge's hammer knocks it down (Y10S2). The plate's size and place, the push's speed, the guard break's and knockdown's lengths are ours.
name: Ballistic Shield
